verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or full-account export capability. The Job Board API returns JSON, but only for offices, departments and published jobs, and it is meant for building careers pages rather than exporting all customer data. Reporting is described only as building and filtering reports, with no export formats mentioned, so no evidence shows a user can take all their data out in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
